text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours while the Fear & Greed Index sits at 73, suggesting investors remain confident despite the pullback. BTC dominance at 58.4% and solid $117B daily volume indicate the market is still functioning with healthy participation rather than panic or exodus. The slight greed contraction over the past week hints at some caution creeping in, though sentiment has not shifted into fear territory.
